name: Nested Nonconstant-Row Enlargement Preserves Ampleness
statement: If $H$ and $D$ are nonempty ample and the contraction of the marked coordinate of $H$ is contained in $D$, then $V(H,D)$ is ample.
proof: Supports avoiding both new coordinates are shattered by $D$, supports containing exactly one are governed by the contraction $C$, and supports containing both are governed by the old reduction $A$. Hence the shadow has $|D|+2|C|+|A|=|D|+|C|+|H|=|V(H,D)|$ faces, equal to the vertex count.
